newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Banks shares rise on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares firmed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday as Audi shares rose slightly to $16.375 from $16.25 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares also rose to $12.125 from $12.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.75 from Wednesday's $10.625 while B shares fell to $10.875 from $11.125.
Turnover in BLC was 500 shares from 4,500 and volume of trade in Audi was 31,043 shares from 19,778. Thursday's turnover included a block of 13,100 Audi shares traded outside the floor at $16.25.
Also traded on the BSE were 1,500 shares of piping maker Eternit at $1.5625 from $1.75 on January 7 when they had last traded.
There was no trade in the three other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 83,969 shares from 106,687 and value was $995,810 against $1,271,079.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.57 percent to 913.71 and the LISPI stock index also fell 1.06 percent to 80.78.
